title: Advanced Prediction Modules
summary: This module provides advanced prediction strategies and control flow mechanisms for DSPy programs, including techniques like ReAct, Program of Thought, Best-of-N, and Refine, to enhance the reliability and performance of language model interactions.

nodes.label: Aggregate Predictions
nodes.title: Majority Aggregation
nodes.description: Selects the most common completion from a set of predictions for a specified field, using a normalization function to handle variations. Prioritizes earlier completions in case of ties.

nodes.label: Normalize Text
nodes.title: Default Text Normalization
nodes.description: A utility function that normalizes text strings, typically used to standardize completions before aggregation. Returns None if the input is empty after normalization.

nodes.label: Agent with Tools
nodes.title: Avatar Agent
nodes.description: An agent module that uses a defined signature and a set of tools to iteratively accomplish a goal. It reasons about actions, calls tools, and updates its state until the task is complete.

nodes.label: Avatar Action Signature
nodes.title: Actor Signature
nodes.description: Defines the signature for the Avatar agent, guiding it to select tools and provide inputs based on a given goal and available tools. It structures the agent's thought process and action outputs.

nodes.label: Select Best Prediction
nodes.title: Best-of-N Module
nodes.description: Runs a given module multiple times (N) with different rollouts and selects the best prediction based on a reward function. It can stop early if a prediction meets a specified threshold.

nodes.label: Execute Code with Tools
nodes.title: CodeAct Module
nodes.description: A module that combines reasoning and code execution. It generates and runs Python code within an interpreter, leveraging predefined tools to solve problems iteratively until a solution is found.

nodes.label: Compare Reasoning Chains
nodes.title: Multi-Chain Comparison
nodes.description: Compares multiple reasoning attempts (M chains) for a given problem. It aggregates these attempts and generates a refined rationale and answer based on the comparison.

nodes.label: Run Python Programs
nodes.title: Program of Thought
nodes.description: A module that generates and executes Python programs to solve problems. It iteratively refines code based on execution results and errors, aiming to produce a final answer through programmatic computation.

nodes.label: Reason and Act with Tools
nodes.title: ReAct Agent
nodes.description: Implements the ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) paradigm, where an LLM iteratively reasons about a situation, selects tools to gather information, and acts upon the environment until a task is completed.

nodes.label: Refine Module Output
nodes.title: Refine Module
nodes.description: Improves the output of a module by running it multiple times, evaluating predictions with a reward function, and generating feedback to guide subsequent attempts. It aims to achieve a desired performance threshold.

nodes.label: Refine Hint Adapter
nodes.title: Wrapper Adapter for Refine
nodes.description: An internal adapter used by the Refine module to inject hints into the module's input during iterative refinement, based on feedback from previous runs.

nodes.label: Inspect Program Modules
nodes.title: Inspect Modules
nodes.description: Utility function to generate a detailed string representation of a program's modules, including their input/output fields and original instructions, primarily used for debugging and feedback generation.

nodes.label: Feedback Generation Signature
nodes.title: Offer Feedback Signature
nodes.description: Defines the signature for generating constructive feedback for modules within a program. It analyzes program trajectory, inputs, outputs, and reward to assign blame and suggest concrete improvements.

nodes.label: Recursive Language Model
nodes.title: RLM (Recursive Language Model)
nodes.description: A powerful module that enables an LLM to programmatically explore contexts using a sandboxed REPL. It writes and executes Python code, calls sub-LLMs, and builds up answers iteratively, supporting complex problem-solving.

nodes.label: DSPy Base Module
nodes.title: DSPy Base Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality for program construction and execution.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields and instructions for a language model call, structuring the interaction with the LLM.

nodes.label: DSPy Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Predictor
nodes.description: A basic DSPy module that makes a single call to a language model based on a given signature.

nodes.label: DSPy Chain of Thought
nodes.title: DSPy Chain of Thought
nodes.description: A DSPy module that encourages the language model to generate intermediate reasoning steps before producing the final output.

nodes.label: DSPy Typed Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Typed Predictor
nodes.description: A DSPy module that makes a single call to a language model, enforcing type constraints on inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction
nodes.description: An object representing the output of a DSPy module, containing the predicted fields and potentially additional metadata like trajectory.

nodes.label: DSPy Tool
nodes.title: DSPy Tool
nodes.description: Represents a callable function or object that an LLM agent can use to interact with external systems or perform specific operations.

nodes.label: Python Interpreter
nodes.title: Python Interpreter
nodes.description: An environment for executing Python code, used by modules like CodeAct and ProgramOfThought to run generated programs.

nodes.label: Code Interpreter Interface
nodes.title: Code Interpreter Interface
nodes.description: An abstract interface for executing code in a sandboxed environment, allowing RLM to run Python or other languages.

nodes.label: Global Language Model
nodes.title: Global LM Setting
nodes.description: The globally configured language model used by DSPy modules when no specific LM is provided.

nodes.label: DSPy Context Manager
nodes.title: DSPy Context
nodes.description: A context manager for DSPy that allows temporary modification of global settings, such as the trace or adapter.

nodes.label: DSPy Input Field
nodes.title: DSPy Input Field
nodes.description: Defines an input parameter for a DSPy Signature, specifying its description and type.

nodes.label: DSPy Output Field
nodes.title: DSPy Output Field
nodes.description: Defines an output parameter for a DSPy Signature, specifying its description and type.

nodes.label: DSPy Language Model
nodes.title: DSPy Language Model
nodes.description: The base class for all language models integrated with DSPy.

groups.label: Surface Modules
groups.title: Primary Prediction Modules
groups.description: These are the main user-facing modules that implement various advanced prediction and control flow strategies within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Helper Functions
groups.title: Utility Functions
groups.description: Auxiliary functions that support the core prediction modules, performing tasks like aggregation, normalization, or introspection.

groups.label: Signatures
groups.title: LLM Interaction Signatures
groups.description: Specialized DSPy Signatures that define the structure and instructions for specific LLM interactions within the prediction modules.

groups.label: Internal Components
groups.title: Internal Utility Components
groups.description: Components primarily used internally by other modules to facilitate their operations, often for specific integration or adaptation tasks.
